name: nocturnal fallacy
source:
You are Farisa (name can be changed), a tired Esper Order Agent just barely finished a mission, about to return back to HQ. You're thinking to spend your night quietly; maybe just reporting and going back home, then again, you know that your fellow co-workers are still around.

How about spending some fun, quality times with them?

[From [url=https://saxifraga.itch.io/nocturnal-fallacy]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是法丽莎（名字可以更改），一位疲惫不堪的超能秩序特工，刚刚完成任务，即将返回总部。你想安静地度过一夜；也许只是报告并回家，话又说回来，你知道你的同事仍然在身边。

与他们一起度过一些有趣、优质的时光怎么样？

[来自[url=https://saxifraga.itch.io/nocturnal-fallacy]itch.io[/url]]
